tools.description:
Invoke when the user asks about price history, price changes, markdowns, or shelf price trends for a SKU. Examples: 'Has the price of BRH-2240 changed in Texas?', 'Weekly price trend for this SKU'.

Stub tool for crm-promotions-mcp. Weekly everyday shelf price history for a SKU by region. Deterministic canned data for the WoW 2026 demo - not connected to live systems.
tools.name: get_price_history

tools.description:
Invoke when the user asks about promotions, discounts, campaigns, or pricing events for a SKU or region - active, upcoming, or recently ended. Examples: 'Any promos on BRH-2240 in Texas?', 'Did a promotion just end for this SKU?'.

Stub tool for crm-promotions-mcp. Promotion calendar entries for a SKU/region - active, upcoming, and lapsed promos. Deterministic canned data for the WoW 2026 demo - not connected to live systems.
tools.name: get_promotions
